A '''Troukree''' was among a group of his fellows, who accompanied [[Vaantaar]] to aid the [[Hand of Judgment]], a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad that deserted from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in a [[Battle for Poln Major|fight]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s troops. He aided [[Unidentified Troukree (sacrifice)|his companion]] in protecting the stormtrooper's leader [[Daric LaRone]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Troukree first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s novel ''[[Choices of One]]'' in [[2011]].
